decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm's core thermoforming materials knowledge for dental labs, so it can interpret results and refine them easily.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a close extension of the established blank portfolio, with high absorptive fit and its own dedicated page signalling commitment.
The UV-curing lacquer relates to the firm's light-curing materials and earmold finishing expertise, but its low website visibility suggests a peripheral role that is still worth refining in-house.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's digital scanning workflow strategy, and its dedicated page and fit with digital manufacturing knowledge favour keeping it.
Custom earmolds are core skilled custom-device manufacturing for hearing-care retailers, where in-house R&D and digital production give strong capacity to improve the line.
Custom hearing protection uses the same earmold impression and digital manufacturing knowledge, so the firm can absorb market feedback and develop the product further.
